summary: A button that opens the browser's print dialog, used to print or save the season file as a PDF.
purpose: Lets a fan print or save their season file.
why: Likely reason: relies on the browser's own print feature instead of building a PDF.
how: Draws a button styled as a Lab button, hidden when printing, and calls the browser print command on click.
risks: Printed output depends on the print rules in lab.css. The button is hidden in print so it does not print itself.
debug: If nothing happens, check whether the browser blocks print dialogs. If the printout looks wrong, check the print rules in lab.css.
